Name: Omni Farm Redone
Author: pluviophist
Description:
[center][font=Times New Roman]This is my rework of [/font][url=https://github.com/lambui/StardewValleyMod_OmniFarm]Omni Farm[/url][font=Times New Roman] by lambui; all credit to the original author![/font][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][font=Times New Roman]Omni farm provides massive amounts of new space, featuring a quarry, regenerating stumps, river fish, minecart stop, and warps to help you navigate the farm easily. My version features a grassier (and all tillable!) landscape, new streams and waterfalls, soundscapes, a spa location, and a few more personal touches.[/font][/center]

[center][font=Times New Roman][b]There are two download options: Combat Farm replacement, or a new farm type. [u]Only download one[/u].[/b] [/font][/center]
[center][line]
[/center]
[center][/center]
[font=Courier New][size=5][size=4]✿[b] Installation[/b][/size][/size][/font]

[list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Make sure to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager[/url]﻿ if you wish for the quarry and regenerative stumps to work.[/font][/*]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Download this mod.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Unzip the mod into your Stardew Valley "Mods/" folder.[/font][/*]
[*][font=Times New Roman]Run the game using SMAPI.[/font][/*]
[/list]
[font=Times New Roman][b]To uninstall, delete this mod from Mods folder.[/b]

[size=4]✿ [/size][font=Times New Roman][size=3][b]Enjoy the map, and please let me know if you come across any issues.[/b][/size][size=4][b] [/b](๑ˇεˇ๑)[b] ♡[/b][/size][/font][/font]

[font=Courier New][size=4]Mods Used in Screenshots[/size][/font]
[font=Times New Roman]Map/Foliage Recolor: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367]Vibrant Pastoral Redrawn[/url][font=Times New Roman] [ + VPR Expanded in optional files ], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Stardew Foliage Redone[/url]
[font=Times New Roman]Buildings: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Gwen's medieval buildings[/url][font=Times New Roman] and [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27579]Italian Countryside Buildings[/url][font=Times New Roman] [[/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27005]Italian Countryside Farmhouse[/url][font=Times New Roman]][/font]
[font=Times New Roman]Craftables: [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13897]Gwen's Craftables for AT[/url][font=Times New Roman] [VPR version], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8683]Gwen's Paths[/url][font=Times New Roman], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16935]Nano's Garden Style Craftables[/url][font=Times New Roman], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24980]Modular Planters[/url][font=Times New Roman], [/font][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20973]Shyzie's String Lights[/url][font=Times New Roman] [/font]
